paragraphs.p0: Let's see how quick notes work in Jot.
paragraphs.p1: Click New note, and an empty note opens.
paragraphs.p2: Type a title — it saves as you type.
paragraphs.p3: Press Share to copy a link for your team.
paragraphs.p4: Jot it down, share it fast.

clips.text: Let's see how quick notes work in Jot.
Click New note, and an empty note opens.
Type a title — it saves as you type.
Press Share to copy a link for your team.
Jot it down, share it fast.
